title: Microsoft DEF 14A definitive proxy statement (est.) — the document that carries the 2026 shareholder-proposal slate and confirms the meeting date
source: EST: NO ANNOUNCED DATE EXISTS FOR THIS FILING — the date below is an INFERENCE FROM A MEASURED CADENCE, not an announcement, and is labelled estimate for exactly that reason. Derived 2026-09-09 from all sixteen Microsoft DEF 14A filings 2010-2025, read from data.sec.gov's own submissions index for CIK 0000789019, each paired with the annual-meeting date printed inside that same filing. The pairing is the point: the CALENDAR date of the filing drifts across Sept 30 - Oct 27, but the LAG from filing to meeting does not — 16-year median 47 days (range 43-50), last-five median 47 days (45, 47, 47, 47, 49). Applying the 47-day median to the confirmed meeting date 2026-12-08 gives 2026-10-22, a Thursday, which is also the weekday of four of the last five filings (2021-10-14 Thu, 2022-10-27 Thu, 2023-10-19 Thu, 2024-10-24 Thu, 2025-10-21 Tue). HONEST WINDOW: the last-five lag range puts the filing at 2026-10-20 (Tue) to 2026-10-24 (Sat, so realistically Fri 2026-10-23); the full sixteen-year range widens it to 2026-10-19..2026-10-26. Treat the entry as that window with a point estimate at its centre, never as a scheduled release. PROMOTION CRITERION: the filing itself appearing on data.sec.gov's CIK0000789019 submissions feed as form DEF 14A flips this to confirmed on a SEC: prefix, on its ACTUAL date. Proposed 2026-09-09 by the msft-annual-meeting-2026-12-08 initial research
notes: PROPOSED by msft-annual-meeting-2026-12-08's never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09, D-90 of the meeting). WHY IT EARNS A ROW RATHER THAN A FOOTNOTE: the DEF 14A, not the meeting, is the document that actually carries information — the shareholder-proposal slate, executive compensation, the director nominees, and the board's own framing of AI capex, all landing this year for the first time after the two-segment recast the 2026-09-02 8-K announced. It is also the mechanical falsifier for the meeting date itself: a DEF 14A naming any date other than 2026-12-08 would break the 8-for-8 record of Microsoft's 10-K-stated meeting date matching the eventual proxy (2018-2025, both sides fetched from sec.gov 2026-09-09) and re-key the whole corridor. THE ANSWER IS ALREADY MEASURED, SO THE SIBLING LANE THAT RESEARCHES THIS NEED NOT RE-DERIVE IT: an n=16 event study of every one of these filing dates 2010-2025 puts MSFT minus QQQ on filing day at mean +0.07%, median -0.10%, win 7/16 — indistinguishable from the 49% base rate. The D->D+5 window looks better at +0.86% mean but its median is -0.32%, because the mean is carried entirely by 2015's +10.14pp, and that window contains the FY16-Q1 print (2015-10-22) rather than anything about the proxy. Drop that one observation and the cell is noise. NO PLAYBOOK FIRES; the honest call on this entry is watch-only, same as its parent. ADJACENCY THAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE FILING ITSELF: the estimated window overlaps the estimated FY27-Q1 print (msft-2026-10-27-print, critical) and the confirmed fomc-2026-10-28 by a few sessions — in 2022 the proxy was filed 10-27, two days after that year's print. Any filing-day tape read in that window is the print's, not the proxy's. KIND: 'sector' for the same reason the parent uses it — KINDS in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs has no company-governance slot.
